description: Use when someone needs to know exactly how a Tickerz index is counted before relying on it: the machine-readable rule (source, query, transform, aggregation, cadence, unit, decimals, precision, revision policy, grade, and settlement rights with the terms page and the quoted clause), its version, and its hash (sha256 of the canonical JSON). settleable says whether a market may settle on it: the source's terms allow it and the grade is not display. Same data as GET /api/indices/{ticker}/rule.

ticker.description: Index ticker, with or without the dollar sign

name: get_rule
title: Index rule
